summary.question: Monitoring shows the received power reported by trx.och75.z unchanged since about t=600 s while neighbouring readings vary. What is the cause?

llm.report: The system could not determine a single cause. It assigned 0.92 probability to the candidate set, not to any individual candidate. The candidates are WSS attenuation drift, instrument misreporting, stale telemetry, WSS filter shift, amplifier gain tilt, or none of these. The oms.S08-S24.amp6 unit was swapped, but the symptoms remained unchanged, so that check did not distinguish among the candidates. The system did not flag a probable unconsidered cause. No further diagnostic step was specified.
